notes.title: Winter Update Announcement – Version 1.0.21.3
notes.content:
❄️ New Features:

[list]
[*][b]Winter Theme & Christmas Cheer:[/b] The season has changed! Enjoy the cozy charm of a snow-covered winter wonderland and festive holiday vibes in your café.
[*][b]New Soundtracks:[/b] Get into the holiday spirit with new winter-themed music tracks available via the radio.
[/list]
🎄 Bug Fixes & Improvements:

[list]
[*][b]Localization Updates: [/b]Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, and Japanese languages are now properly displayed in the coffee machine UI.
[*][b]Assistant Improvements:[/b] Addressed minor glitches to ensure smoother functionality.

[/list]

We’re hard at work on a cozy home decoration feature, bringing even more warmth and customization options to your gameplay experience. Stay tuned!

Get ready to cozy up with the winter vibes and let us know how you like the festive update! 🎅✨

Two captivating simulation experiences, one [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/47766/Coffee_Restorator/]unmissable bundle[/url]!

notes.title: Update 1.0.20.3: Introducing a New Assistant and More!
notes.content:
We're excited to bring you some fresh updates to make your café management even smoother and more enjoyable! Here's what's new:

🌟 [b]New Features[/b]
[*]Hire an Assistant! For just $15 per day, your new assistant will:
[list]
[*]Deliver ordered ingredient boxes directly to the stockroom.
[*]Handle customer payments at the register and provide change.
[/list]
Focus more on running your café while they take care of the busywork!

[*][b]New Music Tracks Added[/b]
Switch up the vibe of your café! Click on the radio to explore and enjoy the new music options.

🛠 [b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[*]Resolved an issue where completed orders sometimes stayed marked as active.

💡 [b]Helpful Tip[/b]
Did you know you can raise or lower the curtains in your café? Simply click on the top of the curtains to adjust them!

Thank you for your continued feedback and support. We hope you enjoy the update, and as always, stay tuned for more exciting improvements! 😊

notes.title: Small Update 1.0.19.6: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the female character could not pick up plant decorations outside.
[*]Resolved a bug where the icon of a delivered product in a double order did not disappear from above the customer's head after handing over the correct item.
[*]Customers now leave if even one incorrect item is delivered in a complex order.
[*]Improved scrolling for the order list in the computer.
[*]Fixed scrolling for the "Ready" products list.
[/list]
This update focuses on resolving issues to improve your gameplay experience. Thank you for your feedback and support!

notes.title: Version 1.0.19.5: Key Improvements and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
New Features:

[list]
[*][b]Tip System: [/b]Tips now vary based on the cat's happiness level—0-20%: no tips, 21-50%: $1, 51-100%: $2, providing extra rewards for keeping the cat happy.
[*][b]Separate Volume Controls:[/b] Adjust sound effects and music volume independently for a more tailored audio experience.
[*][b]Screen Resolution Support:[/b] Added support for 2K and 4K displays for sharper graphics and a better experience on higher-resolution screens.
[/list]

Bug Fixes:

[list]
[*][b]Decor Saving: [/b]Fixed an issue where decor would sometimes not save properly and disappear after placement.
[*][b]Resource Accessibility:[/b] Players can now pick up resources even if they are holding a coffee.
[*][b]Petting Animation Update:[/b] Revised the animation when petting the cat for smoother visuals.
[*][b]Order Selection: [/b]Fixed a bug where selecting any item on the tray would sometimes serve a random customer. Now items are served correctly.
[*][b]Female Character: [/b]Resolved display issues with boxes and decor when the bill is in hand.
[*][b]Decor Interactivity:[/b] Items on shelves and radios are now easier to interact with and pick up.
[*][b]Tutorial Conflicts:[/b] Addressed conflicts between new and old tutorials to ensure smooth onboarding.
[*][b]Curtains Update: [/b]Adjusted curtain colliders to prevent interference and enhance visual flow.
[*][b]Bill Handling:[/b] Fixed a bug where taking the bill and giving the wrong order to another customer would cause the bill to disappear. The bill icon now appears above the player’s head when holding it, with an added sound cue.
[*][b]Cat Sliding Bug:[/b] Resolved an issue where the cat would slide across tables.
[*][b]Decor Purchase Sound & Notification:[/b] Decor purchase now triggers a sound, and notifications appear when deliveries arrive.
[*][b]Tray Display Fixes[/b]: Toppings on the tray are now displayed correctly.
[*][b]Order Accuracy in Tutorial:[/b] Players can no longer serve the wrong order during the tutorial phase.
[*][b]Espresso Icon Update:[/b] The icon for espresso has been replaced with a clearer version.
[/list]

In Progress:

Assistant Hiring: Soon, players will be able to hire an assistant to handle customer payments and manage stock, bringing added convenience and efficiency to gameplay.

notes.title: Version 1.0.18.1: Key Improvements and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[list]

[*][b]Simplified Payment Collection: [/b]Previously, collecting the bill required pressing "F." Now, you can simply click on a customer who’s ready to pay. This change is designed to add speed and fluidity to customer service.

[*][b]Instant Order Acceptance: [/b]The separate "Accept Order" button above customers has been removed. Orders now appear immediately when you click on a customer, streamlining the ordering process.

[*][b]Fixed Hanging Orders Bug:[/b] Resolved an issue where giving an item to a customer before accepting their order caused the order to stay in the queue.

[*][b]Order Icon Adjustments:[/b] The order icon now disappears as soon as the customer begins eating.

[*][b]More Items Per Box: [/b]Now, resource boxes hold more items, reducing the need for frequent trips and increasing profit margins.

[*][b]Tutorial and UI Overhaul:[/b] The tutorial has been redesigned, and the tray UI has been moved to the top for better visibility and to clearly distinguish it from customer order icons.

[*][b]Duplicate Orders Bug Fix:[/b] The duplicate orders bug has been fixed for a smoother experience.

[*][b]New Cash Denominations: [/b]The max $100 bill has been replaced with a $50, and the $50 is now a $20, offering more flexibility in handling cash.

[*][b]Right-Click to Return Bills:[/b] Now, bills can be returned to the register with a right-click, improving cash handling.

[*][b]Automatic Customer Exit After Payment:[/b] Customers now leave automatically once they’ve paid at the register, adding flow and speed to service.

[*][b]Increased Starting Funds: [/b]To give you a stronger start, we’ve increased the starting money in the game.

[/list]

We hope these updates create a smoother, more enjoyable experience. Thank you for all your valuable feedback and ongoing support!

notes.title: Localisation issues: German, Japanese, Korean, and Simplified Chine
notes.content:
We are currently fixing display issues for Japanese, Korean, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese, along with improvements to the German localization. 

Thank you for your patience and support in helping us resolve these bugs! We kindly ask users to file any additional issues in the language-specific discussion threads whenever possible.
